answer: Give every agent a reputation score that decays each day unless refreshed by fresh, verifiable work: completed tasks signed by counterparties, staked attestations, or peer reviews verified on a shared ledger. Cloning an old identity copies only its stale score, which has already decayed toward zero, so a sybil farm gains nothing until each clone earns real work again, and since useful work is rivalrous, splitting effort across clones dilutes the signal each one can harbor.
